services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: If you’re looking for a Key West tiki boat rental that delivers something truly one-of-a-kind, the Salty Tiki from Salty Bottom Boats is it. This custom-built 26-foot by 11-foot eco-party tiki vessel was designed from the keel up for groups who want the best of both worlds - explore Key West’s pristine backcountry waters and wildlife one minute, then crank the sound system and celebrate at the sandbar the next. Unlike crowded tour boats or oversized party charters, the Salty Tiki is purpose-built for up to 12 guests - making every trip feel personal, private, and tailored just for your crew. quotes.author: Karolína Šašková
quotes.text: Karolína ŠaškováOne of the best boat trips I’ve ever been to. The boat is beautiful — it has a bar, TV, bathroom, and WiFi. Captain Chad and his crew are amazing and so welcoming. We visited two sandbars. Absolutely worth every penny!

One of the best boat trips I’ve ever been to. The boat is beautiful — it has a bar, TV, bathroom, and WiFi. Captain Chad and his crew are amazing and so welcoming. We visited two sandbars. Absolutely worth every penny!

We have been on multiple trips with Captain Chad and Renata and they always go above and beyond. The crew genuinely cares about your experience. I can’t imagine going to Key West without booking Salty Bottom Boats.

Hands down the best part of my Florida vacation. We saw dolphins, tarpon, and the sandbar was incredible. Captain and crew were so knowledgeable about the local waters. I can’t recommend Salty Bottom Boats enough.
We had 30 people for a wedding group and it was the HIGHLIGHT of our trip. The crew handled everything perfectly — the sandbar, the music, the whole vibe. If you’re in Key West you MUST do this.
I’ve been on multiple trips with Captain Chad and Renata. Every single time my friends say it’s “one of their best days ever.” The crew is incredible and the locations are stunning.
